title: Twenty traps moved where agents read them

text:
Every hard-won trap in the code skill was filed in a backlog nobody loads - twenty entries since 2026-09-04, none ever applied. Now folded into the skill itself, grouped by how they actually fail rather than listed one by one: 41 lines in, 31 lines of backlog out.

Three of them are from today, including the one that cost you a broken page: a `@layer util` class beats a component stylesheet no matter the specificity.

Nothing on your screen changed. This is the file agents load before they touch your site.
